game_title: Phone Book Rescue – Ice Cave Shelter Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter, a shelter in an ice cave: the mountaineer must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter: a shelter in an ice cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Cave Shelter, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the mountaineer ahead. Then check the contacts value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the flag pole by solving code steps involving contacts that move the mountaineer forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the flag pole first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phone Book Rescue' (Week 8 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ice Cave Shelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how contacts changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
